questions.prompt: Why does Rust move a `String` on assignment instead of making an implicit copy?

options.a: Copying heap strings is explicitly forbidden by the language grammar
options.b: `String` owns heap memory; an implicit copy would be expensive and risk double-free errors, so ownership transfers instead
options.c: It is a temporary limitation of the compiler architecture

questions.prompt: After a variable has been moved from, what state is the original variable in?

options.c: It is compile-time dead — referencing or naming it at all is a build error
